definitions.global_metric_rank: Deterministic ordinal rank over the full valid 2300-sketch historical population for the role metric and predeclared direction. Exact metric ties are resolved by stable_tie_key ascending.
definitions.eligible_pool_rank: Deterministic ordinal rank after applying the role's predeclared eligibility restriction, using the same metric direction and stable_tie_key tie-break.

restricted_roles.S01: Eligible sketches belong to identities whose canonical H3 test fold is 3.
restricted_roles.S08: Eligible sketches belong to the frozen 582-row I4 text-positive pool.

definitions.unrestricted_roles: For S02-S07, S09, and S10, global_metric_rank and eligible_pool_rank are identical.
definitions.collision_rule: Identity-collision skips do not alter either rank. Each skipped higher-ranked candidate and the already-selected conflicting sentinel role are logged separately.

scientific_effect: Bookkeeping only. This addendum does not change any role metric, eligibility rule, selection order, tie-break rule, or sentinel-selection outcome.
